A transition state from an ORCA B3LYP-D4/def2-TZVP `OptTS Freq` job: a 37-atom anion with a triflate group
(`S14`, `O16`, `O17`, `C18`, `F19`–`F21` and the bridging `O22`). The frequency calculation found one
imaginary mode. The question is which atoms that mode moves.

**Files used** (from the repository):

* `files/orb.out` — ORCA, B3LYP-D4/def2-TZVP CPCM(toluene) OptTS Freq, one imaginary frequency, C₁₆H₁₃F₄O₃S⁻

**1. Localise the imaginary mode.** With the default `-m -1` every imaginary mode is selected; `--ipr`
adds the inverse participation ratio.

```bash
frog-hessian files/orb.out --ipr
```

```text
ℹ  Processing file: files/orb.out
ℹ  Selected imaginary modes: [6]
     Atomic Contributions
        (files/orb.out)
╭──────┬──────────────────────╮
│ Atom │ Mode 6 (-356.9 cm⁻¹) │
├──────┼──────────────────────┤
│ C0   │                36.56 │
│ S14  │                12.42 │
│ C15  │                10.66 │
│ O22  │                 7.94 │
│ H23  │                11.44 │
╰──────┴──────────────────────╯
    Inverse Participation Ratio
          (files/orb.out)
╭──────┬──────────────────┬────────╮
│ Mode │ Frequency (cm⁻¹) │    IPR │
├──────┼──────────────────┼────────┤
│    6 │           -356.9 │ 0.1853 │
╰──────┴──────────────────┴────────╯
```

* Mode 6 (−356.9 cm⁻¹) is the only imaginary mode. Above the 5 % threshold it moves `C0` (36.56 %),
  `S14` (12.42 %), `H23` (11.44 %), `C15` (10.66 %) and `O22` (7.94 %).
* IPR = 0.1853, against 1/N ≈ 0.03 for a motion spread evenly over the 37 atoms. The mode is
  localised on a handful of atoms, as a TS mode should be. Check that these are the atoms of the bond
  you meant to make or break.

**2. Fragments, a lower threshold and a movie of the mode.** Fragments sum the full contributions (not only
those shown). `-d` writes 11 frames from −0.6 to +0.6 into `displ/`.

```bash
frog-hessian files/orb.out -t 2 --fragment "OTf:14,16,17,18,19,20,21,22" --fragment "CH2:15,35,36" --fragment "C0:0" -d --number-geometries 11 --out-dir displ
```

* With `-t 2` four more atoms appear (`O16` 4.18 %, `O17` 2.18 %, `C18` 2.44 %, `H36` 4.51 %).
* By fragment: the triflate atoms (`OTf` = S, O, CF₃ and the bridging `O22`) carry 30.49 %, the CH₂ group 15.88 % and `C0` alone 36.56 %.
  The remaining ~17 % sits mostly on `H23`.
* Open `displ/orb_mode6_displ.xyz` as an animation in a viewer to see the motion. The first and last
  frames are good starting points for IRC-like optimisations towards reactant and product.
